messages:
Ravi: Heads up - new prospect (FinCo) needs a Dedicated POC. They specifically asked for a single static IPv4 egress plus mutual TLS to their appliance. No IPv6 required.
Claire: Good, that's straightforward. We can give a reserved egress IP and set up an ingress mTLS if they can accept a customer-side proxy (they provide certs) OR we can spin a Private sandbox.
Omar: For many customers we do: Dedicated sandbox (our infra) + their proxy terminating mTLS -> our endpoint. We validate the proxy via HMAC header.
Ravi: What do we tell them about cert rotation and emergency revocation?
Claire: We ask for contact + rotation policy. For short-lived POCs we accept a 90-day rotation window but require an emergency revocation contact.
Omar: I'll queue the dedicated-sandbox job and allocate a reserved egress IP. infra-bot: sandbox:allocating egress ip 34.23.112.45 id=sb-99
Ravi: Perfect. Can we provide a minimal curl example for their ops team to test connectivity?
Claire: Sure, sample when proxy does mTLS to their firewall and presents X-Forwarded-Client-Cert:
```bash
curl -v https://34.23.112.45/v1/generate \
  -H "X-Forwarded-Client-Cert: $(cat /path/to/client.pem | base64)" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer DEDICATED-TEMP-KEY" \
  -d '{"input":"test"}'
```
Ravi: Any other blockers?
Omar: Security questionnaire and network diagram. Also confirm timezone for cert rotation handoff during POC.
Ravi: I'll email FinCo with the checklist and reserved IP. infra-bot: sandbox:ready id=sb-99 egress_ip=34.23.112.45
Claire: Provided the reserved IP in the email. Ravi: Thanks, will follow up after their security team signs off.
